# Greenly

> > Greenly provides carbon accounting and sustainability management solutions helping businesses achieve Net Zero through CSRD compliance, Scope 3 emissions tracking, and decarbonization strategies.

Greenly SAS, headquartered in Paris with offices in New York, offers carbon management software and consulting services for companies across tech, retail, manufacturing, and finance sectors. The platform enables organizations to measure their carbon footprint, comply with regulations like CSRD and SBTi, and implement science-based decarbonization strategies.

## Key Topics

- Carbon accounting and emissions tracking
- CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) compliance
- Net Zero strategy and implementation
- Scope 3 emissions measurement
- SBTi (Science Based Targets initiative)
- ESG reporting and sustainability strategy
- Decarbonization pathways
- Carbon footprint calculation
- Regulatory compliance (SB 253, SB 261, CBAM)
- Sustainability consulting
- Green IT and digital carbon footprint
- Supply chain carbon management
- Carbon credits and removal projects
- Industry-specific solutions (tech, retail, manufacturing)

- [Iconia - CBAM](https://greenly.earth/en-gb/case-study/iconia-cbam): Case study: How Iconia tackles CBAM compliance with Greenly
- [Sustainability Solutions for Chemical Manufacturers](https://greenly.earth/en-gb/resources/chemical-manufacturing-one-pager): One-pager: CSRD & SBTi compliance for chemical manufacturers
